headword: {遠隔|えんかく}{教育|きょういく}

definitions.explanation: a method of education where students learn without being physically present at a school or institution

examples.japanese: {遠隔|えんかく}{教育|きょういく}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{学位|がくい}→学位：10196_gakui⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{取|と}る→取る：00565_toru⟧。

notes:
Refers to any form of education delivered to learners who are not physically in a classroom. Composed of ⟦{遠隔|えんかく}→遠隔：14381_enkaku⟧ (remote, distant) + ⟦{教育|きょういく}→教育：01313_kyouiku⟧ (education). The concept existed before the internet via correspondence courses (⟦{通信|つうしん}{教育|きょういく}→通信教育：09975_tsuushinkyouiku⟧), but gained massive attention during and after the COVID-19 pandemic.

- {遠隔|えんかく}{教育|きょういく}⟦システム→システム：08428_shisutemu⟧ — distance education system
- {遠隔|えんかく}{教育|きょういく}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{導入|どうにゅう}する→導入する：16055_dounyuusuru⟧ — to introduce distance education
- {遠隔|えんかく}{教育|きょういく}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{課題|かだい}→課題：00132_kadai⟧ — challenges of distance education
- {遠隔|えんかく}{教育|きょういく}⟦{環境|かんきょう}→環境：00174_kankyou⟧ — distance education environment
